messages:
olivia.p: Quick sync — we need to finalize the tolerance matrix for model migrations and define a clear customer rollback path for tier-1 customers. I sketched a proposal, want feedback before I write the spec.

devon.product: +1. Core ask from sales: predictable migration windows, automatic rollback for serious regressions, and a pinned opt-out for enterprise deals.

tia.cs: From support: customers expect rollback within 1h for production outages. For non-prod they're ok with 24–48h. Also want clear communication templates.

ryan.eng: Ops reality: we can implement an automated fallback to an older pinned model or to a lower-cost quantized variant. Circuit-breaker triggers are straightforward: error rate, p95 latency, or regression on eval can fire a rollback.

sanjay.m: For metrics, propose thresholds (anchor = current prod baseline). Quick draft:```
quality_delta <= -0.75% avg (core eval set)
hallucination_delta <= +0.2 percentage points
p95_latency_delta <= +35ms
cost_per_token_delta <= +5%
```If any of these fail during canary → block rollout.

olivia.p: That looks good. Propose rollout phases: internal dev-only (2h), staging with synthetic load (6h), beta customers (48h), gradual traffic ramp (10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 3 days). Canary sampling min: 5k completions or 24h real traffic, whichever is first.

devon.product: For enterprise pinned customers: auto-pin for 60 days after migration unless customer opts out. If they request exception we need a signed opt-out and support plan.

tia.cs: Communication plan: pre-migration notice 7 days, migration day 2h heads-up, post-migration health check email within 24h. If rollback occurs, send incident summary + mitigation steps within 4h.

ryan.eng: Circuit-breaker specifics: if error_rate > 1% over 10m OR p95_latency > 500ms sustained for 10m OR quality regression > thresholds on A/B stats -> auto-rollback to last stable model. Also log and tag traffic for forensic replay.

catalog-bot: compat-checker finished: vX.3 -> 4 failing prompts out of 120 on "billing prompts" subset. Link: https://redwood.internal/compat/202345/summary (internal only).

sanjay.m: For the A/B during canary we need 5k real completions *and* eval suite run on production prompts. Acceptable false positive tuning on stats so we don't roll back for noise. Also define manual hold gates: product + eng + cs signoff for high-risk customers.

olivia.p: Action items: (1) I'll draft the spec with phases, thresholds, circuit-breaker rules, communication templates; (2) @ryan.eng to draft ops playbook and rollback scripts; (3) @sanjay.m to formalize eval suite + runbook; (4) @tia.cs to prepare customer comms. Aim to review tomorrow 09:30 PT.

ryan.eng: I'll stub the rollback runbook and a hook for auto-fallback by EOD.

sanjay.m: I'll codify the eval thresholds and add a small smoke test harness (can run in staging).

tia.cs: I'll prepare the 7-day, 2h, and 24h templates and customer FAQ.

devon.product: Thanks — if we can get this into a spec today we can present to sales Thursday.

olivia.p: Sweet. If anyone has edge-case asks (e.g., regulatory customers, on-prem private deployments) drop them here — we should add special handling to the spec. :thumbsup:

ryan.eng: note: for private deployments we can't auto-rollback remotely; add a manual rollback checklist + artifacts to ship.

olivia.p: noted, will add a "private deployment" appendix. Thanks all :rocket:

devon.product: :thumbsup:
